citation: UAE Cabinet Decision No. (58) of 2020 Regulating the Beneficial Owner Procedures: a beneficial owner is a natural person who owns or controls, directly or indirectly, 25% or more of the legal person's shares or voting rights, or otherwise exercises control. Confirm the article and the revision in force with the institution's compliance officer before go-live; free-zone and financial-free-zone (DIFC, ADGM) entities have their own registers.
